segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ הַנּוֹדֵר מִיּוֹרְדֵי הַיָּם — מוּתָּר בְּיוֹשְׁבֵי הַיַּבָּשָׁה. מִיּוֹשְׁבֵי הַיַּבָּשָׁה — אָסוּר מִיּוֹרְדֵי הַיָּם, שֶׁיּוֹרְדֵי הַיָּם בִּכְלַל יוֹשְׁבֵי הַיַּבָּשָׁה. לֹא כְּאֵלּוּ שֶׁהוֹלְכִים מֵעַכּוֹ לְיָפוֹ, אֶלָּא בְּמִי שֶׁדַּרְכּוֹ לְפָרֵשׁ.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» In the case of «one who takes a vow» that he will not derive benefit «from seafarers,» he is «permitted» to benefit «from those who live on dry land.» But if he takes a vow not to derive benefit «from those who live on dry land,» he is also «prohibited» from deriving benefit «from seafarers, because seafarers are included» within the category of «those who live on dry land.» The mishna now defines seafarers: «Not like those that travel» by ship «from Akko to Jaffa,» which is a short trip, «but rather one who customarily departs [lefaresh]» to distant locations, e.g., foreign countries.

moves.summary: Vow from seafarers permits dry-land dwellers
Vow from dry-land dwellers forbids seafarers too
Seafarers are those who customarily travel far

positions.claim: seafarers are included in dwellers on dry land; seafarers means those who travel far
